versions.changelog:
- Removed the skill-card.md file to simplify and streamline documentation.
- No user-facing functionality changes.
- Documentation and usage instructions remain in SKILL.md.

- Removed the file skill-card.md for streamlined maintenance.
- SKILL.md updated: no longer documents or supports the use of the secret query parameter in preview links; links are now always just {QUIZ_BASE}/b/{publicToken}, with nothing appended.
- Minor clarifications to link-handling instructions and references to the preview process for simplicity.
- No changes to API endpoints or core workflow.

- The internal quiz scene type in the JSON payload has changed from "outcome" to "outcome_quiz".
- The documentation, instructions, and example JSON now specify `"scene": "outcome_quiz"` as required for this skill.
- Removed unused documentation file (skill-card.md) for a leaner repository.

- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No changes to code or functionality.
- Documentation and usage remain as previously specified.

- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- No functional or behavioral changes to the skill itself.

- Initial release of the preview-outcome skill for building and previewing RooQuiz personality/type tests.
- Instantly creates a shareable, temporary (~1 hour) browser link; no account, login, or API key needed.
- Designed for "which X are you" / archetype quizzes where options vote for result types and the top-voted type is shown as the result.
- Provides detailed instructions, sample JSON structure, supported question types, and visual theme options.
- Includes links and environment variable options for both the default RooQuiz cloud and self-hosted deployments.
- For graded or scored quizzes, recommends sibling skills: preview-quiz (right/wrong) and preview-scorecard (score into a level).
